name: Audio Player
description: Provides field formatters and a Views style for audio files with customizable skins, playlists, color palettes, and equalizers.
project_description: Audio Player renders audio held in core File fields or Media (audio bundle) references as a themeable, self-contained HTML5 player built on jQuery and vanilla JS bundled with the module (no CDN, no external library). It supplies two field formatters plus a Views style plugin. A single file plays as one track; multiple files can be shown as looped singles or as a playlist. Presentation is chosen per display: 18 single-audio skins, 2-3 playlist skins, ~20 color palettes and ~27 canvas equalizer visualisations, all overridable via Twig templates and CSS in a theme. The player resolves each track from its managed-file URI and checks file view access before emitting a URL, so it inherits Drupal's private-file protection. It ships no routes, permissions, services, config entities or config schema.
